## Summary

Describe the change and the maintainer/user problem it solves.

## Validation

List the commands, fixtures, or tests used to validate the change.

## Safety / evidence impact

Does this change affect sandboxing, secret handling, deterministic reproduction, report schemas, or harness capability claims? Explain the impact or write `None`.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change focused and documented behavior changes.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not add undocumented harness flags or capabilities.
- [ ] I did not weaken the host/sandbox trust boundary.
- [ ] I updated relevant docs or changelog entries.
